description: Hand-annotated ground truth of business rules and entities in legacy_customer_orders_etl.sql, used only for PoC evaluation metrics (Business Rule Extraction Coverage, Entity Grounding Accuracy).

business_rules.name: Customer Region Mapping
business_rules.description: region_code is mapped to a full region name: NA -> North America, EU -> Europe, AP -> Asia Pacific, else Unknown.

business_rules.name: Customer Tier Classification
business_rules.description: Customer tier assigned by lifetime_value thresholds: >=50000 PLATINUM, >=15000 GOLD, >=2000 SILVER, else STANDARD.

business_rules.name: Tier-Based Discount
business_rules.description: Order line discount is based on customer tier: PLATINUM 15%, GOLD 10%, SILVER 5%, STANDARD 0%.

business_rules.name: Order Aging Discount Exception
business_rules.description: An additional 2% discount is applied if the order is more than 90 days old at processing time. This is an undocumented exception layered on top of BR-03.
business_rules.note: Business justification for the 90-day threshold and 2% value is not documented anywhere in the source system.

business_rules.name: Order Status Normalization
business_rules.description: Raw order status codes are normalized into four buckets: CANCELLED, FULFILLED, IN_PROGRESS, UNKNOWN, based on string matching against known legacy status codes.

business_rules.name: Active Customer Filter
business_rules.description: Only customers with active_flag = 'Y' are loaded into staging; inactive customers are silently excluded.

business_rules.name: 2-Year Order Window
business_rules.description: Only orders from the last 24 months are processed into staging. Reason for this specific window is not documented in the source.

business_rules.name: Customer Dimension SCD Type 1
business_rules.description: dim_customers is refreshed using an overwrite (SCD Type 1) strategy — no history of customer attribute changes is retained.
